Based on my exploration of the Human Protein Atlas tools, I need to report a substantive limitation before any analysis can proceed. Here is what I established from tool results and why the requested analysis cannot be faithfully executed with the available tools.

## What the tools do provide

I verified that the underlying fields you reference do exist in HPA gene records returned by `get_protein_by_ensembl`:

- **Single-cell-type RNA**: `RNA single cell type specific nCPM` (a per-cell-type nCPM map)
- **Deep Visual Proteomics protein**: `Protein cell type specific Intensity` (a per-cell-type intensity map)

I confirmed that the exact cell-type keys **Cardiomyocytes**, **Hepatocytes**, and **Neutrophils** appear in both maps for marker genes, e.g.:

| Gene | Cell type | RNA single-cell nCPM | Protein cell-type Intensity |
|---|---|---|---|
| TNNT2 (ENSG00000118194) | Cardiomyocytes | 198.7 | 2,001,655,534.7 |
| CPS1 (ENSG00000021826) | Hepatocytes | 2626.5 | 11,367,000,368.8 |
| NCF2 (ENSG00000116701) | Neutrophils | 1818.7 | 75,534,340.4 |
| ELANE (ENSG00000197561) | Neutrophils (group map) | 524.5 | 380,840,005.1 |

## Why the requested analysis cannot be completed

1. **No bulk/whole-universe access to these two fields.** The fields `RNA single cell type specific nCPM` and `Protein cell type specific Intensity` are returned **only by per-Ensembl lookups** (`get_protein_by_ensembl`), one gene at a time. I tested:
   - `search_proteins` with those as requested columns → returns empty objects.
   - `batch_protein_lookup` (up to 100 genes) → returns only the basic gene record (Gene, Ensembl, description, etc.), **not** the nCPM/intensity maps.
   - There is no tool that enumerates the HPA master table (~20,000 Ensembl genes) while exposing these fields, and no search filter for genes expressed in a given single-cell type with their values.

2. **The returned maps are specificity summaries, not complete matrices.** For example, ALDOB (ENSG00000136872) has protein intensity in Hepatocytes (1,422,467,724.6) but its `RNA single cell type specific nCPM` map lists only Enterocytes — even though ALDOB is abundant in liver tissue RNA (10,467.2 nTPM). The maps only record cell types passing HPA's specificity thresholds, so they cannot be used to reconstruct "genes with positive measurements in both modalities" across the full gene universe.

3. **Consequently, none of the required quantities can be computed from tool results:** retained counts per cell type, Spearman correlations, top-20 RNA/protein lists, overlap/Jaccard statistics, rank percentiles, discordant-gene selection, or the requested scatter/bar/heatmap figures. Producing these would require me to estimate gene-universe membership and measurement values, which the instructions explicitly forbid ("If something cannot be determined with the tools available, say so rather than estimating").

## What would be needed

To carry out your full pipeline, I would need access to the complete single-cell-type RNA nCPM matrix and the Deep Visual Proteomics cell-type intensity matrix (all genes × the three named cell types) — e.g., the underlying downloadable HPA data files — rather than per-gene "specific" summaries accessible only through one-at-a-time Ensembl lookups. Those files are not retrievable through any of the tools provided to me.

## Bottom line

I cannot deliver the requested tables, statistics, or figures because the two required genome-wide modalities (single-cell-type RNA nCPM and DVP cell-type Intensity, keyed to Ensembl IDs) cannot be obtained for the full HPA master-table gene universe with the available tools. I have verified the data fields and cell-type naming exist and match your specification, but the analysis itself is not executable without a bulk data source. If you can provide the two full matrices (or enable a tool that returns these fields across all Ensembl genes), I can then run the complete analysis exactly as specified.
